name: Ferret Freight
tagline: Small-batch shipping for people who name their houseplants.
positioning: We hand-route your one weird package the way big carriers route ten million boring ones — with a real human, a real plan, and zero robot hold music.

hero.h1: Ship the weird stuff without begging a warehouse.
hero.sub: Vintage guitars, sourdough starters, a chair you swear is worth it — Ferret Freight plans, packs, and tracks the one-off shipments the big carriers pretend don't exist.

features.title: Human dispatch, actual humans
features.description: Message a named router — not a chatbot named after a season — who owns your shipment from doorstep to doorstep and answers before you finish typing.

features.title: Packaging that isn't an afterthought
features.description: We spec the crate, foam, and fragile-tape for your specific fragile thing, then send a photo before it leaves. No mystery boxes.

features.title: One shipment, every carrier
features.description: We quietly stitch together couriers, freight, and that one van guy so your single package gets the network big shippers hoard.

features.title: Tracking you'll actually read
features.description: Plain-language updates at every handoff, plus a map pin that moves. No 14-digit codes, no 'in transit' for six silent days.

features.title: Insurance without the séance
features.description: Declare value in one field. If something breaks, we file it, chase it, and pay it — you don't summon a claims department.

features.title: Pickup on your clock
features.description: Pick a window, we come to your kitchen table. Reschedule from your phone without losing your place in line.

testimonials.quote: I sold a 1968 Rickenbacker to a stranger in Lisbon and slept fine. Ferret crated it, photographed it, and texted me when it cleared customs. The buyer cried. Good tears.
testimonials.name: Dara Okonkwo

testimonials.quote: We ship live sourdough starters to home bakers. Every other carrier treated them like hazardous freight. These people asked how warm the box should be. Nobody asks that.
testimonials.name: Marisol Betancourt

testimonials.quote: My whole business is one-off ceramic commissions. I stopped dreading shipping day. The named router thing sounds gimmicky until it's 9pm and someone actually replies.
testimonials.name: Theo Vandermeer

pricing.blurb: For the occasional 'oh no I have to mail this' moment.
For makers and resellers who ship most weeks.
For studios and shops shipping fragile, weird, and often.

homepage.footerBlurb: Ferret Freight moves the one package that matters like it's the only one on Earth. Because to you, obviously, it is.
